quarterly_data.quarter: Illumina press release: Illumina launches BioInsight Platform, its first unified (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: On October 14, 2026 Illumina debuted the Illumina BioInsight Platform, which it calls its first unified software environment: one single-sign-on environment bringing together its informatics applications (DRAGEN, Emedgene, Connected Multiomics, BioInsight Platform Core, BaseSpace and BioInsight Data), its genomic AI models from the BioInsight AI Lab (including the SpliceAI2 model) and curated datasets for oncology, rare disease, population health and multiomics. A usage-based BioInsight Credits model replaces traditional annual subscriptions. The platform includes the newly released DRAGEN v4.6, whose new deployment options, including DRAGEN software mode, let organizations run DRAGEN across supported cloud and standard CPU environments; with the Global Parkinson's Genetics Program (GP2), DRAGEN is supporting approximately 170 active research projects. The BioInsight business unit (Illumina's data, software, informatics and AI business, which also includes programs such as the Billion Cell Atlas with biopharma partners) was created one year ago. Rami Mehio (SVP and GM of BioInsight): 'we are only getting started'; customers on the platform will get access to new capabilities in the future.
